hero.headline: The DMV's biggest nights out for young adults.
hero.lede: We build the night around meeting people. Dance lessons to begin the night, a live band, and a few hundred young adults. Come on your own, bring friends, or make it a date night. Plenty of people here have met the person they married.

story.heading: The lost art of the evening.
story.lede: An antidote to modern nightlife: big bands, swing dancing, salsa, and real friendship across the District’s most iconic spaces.
story.body:
DC Social Collective launched in 2021 to reclaim a fractured social scene. Five years later, it draws more than 6,000 young adults a year to sold-out rooms across the DMV.

Most guests are in their twenties and thirties, arriving from every background, profession, and corner of the city. You never need a date or a partner to walk through the door. Come solo, take the beginner lesson, and you will have danced with half a dozen people before the band finishes its first set.
